root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ClientMailTemplatesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ClientMailTemplatesTbl ( ClientMailTemplateID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_ClientMailTemplatesTbl PRIMARY KEY, TemplateName NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, Subject NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ClientMailTemplates_Subject DEFAULT (N''), HeaderText NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, BodyText NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, FooterText NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, DateLastChange DATETIME NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_ClientMailTemplates_Name UNIQUE (TemplateName) ); END
